retrievalProfile.description: A top-down conceptual illustration featuring a realistic, jewelry-laden hand controlling small, crude ink doodles via strings on a piece of lined notebook paper.
triggerTerms: diamond rings on hand over notebook
urban sketch style with realistic hand
excludeWhen: the subject is a full human figure

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, realistically rendered dark-skinned hand adorned with heavy diamond jewelry rests atop a sheet of torn-out notebook paper. Thin black strings extend from the fingers to control several simple, ballpoint-pen style stick-figure doodles at the bottom. The contrast between the high-detail, textured hand and the flat, amateurish sketches creates a narrative of control and creation.
coreVisualRelationships: Realistic hand vs. crude ink doodles
High-value jewelry vs. low-value notebook paper
Vertical strings connecting the hand to the figures
Top-down perspective with slight drop shadows
coreInvariants: Lined notebook paper background with torn edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, realistic hand dominates the center-top, scaled to appear as if resting on the paper.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central diamond ring on the middle finger acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the jeweled wrist down the hand, follows the strings to the doodles at the bottom, and then to the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white space of the notebook paper provides breathing room for the detailed hand and the scattered doodles.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white paper and the dark hand; low saturation except for the skin and jewelry highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Mimics felt-tip marker or ballpoint pen strokes
Inconsistent baseline to simulate natural handwriting
characterSpecificRedesigns: Double-lined strokes for emphasis in display text
Rough, bleeding edges as if on porous paper
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of aggressive marker-style block letters with thin, casual ballpoint pen cursive.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, thick-stroke feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down view of a piece of lined notebook paper with a torn left edge. Place a realistic dark-skinned hand in the center, wearing multiple large diamond rings and a gold/diamond bracelet. From the fingertips, draw thin black strings leading down to several crude, black-ink stick figure doodles at the bottom of the page. Include a yellow pencil in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, marker-style uppercase text in the top right corner and casual ballpoint-style cursive text in the top left, ensuring the ink looks like it is absorbed into the paper texture.

verificationChecks: Hand looks realistic with detailed skin texture
Jewelry has specular highlights and sparkle
Doodles look intentionally amateurish and flat
Text appears as if written directly on the paper

mustAchieve: Clear narrative of control via strings

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the strings connect logically from fingers to doodles
Check that the jewelry looks high-end and detailed
Verify the contrast between the 3D hand and 2D paper elements
Confirm the handwriting looks natural and not like a standard font
recipe.reuseFormula: Realistic [Subject A] + [Subject B] + [Subject C] + [Subject D] = [Narrative Concept]
